name: add_message_attachments_and_read_receipts
query: ALTER TABLE public."Message" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "attachmentUrl" text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "attachmentType" text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "attachmentName" text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "isDelivered" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "readAt" timestamptz; ALTER TABLE public."Message" ALTER COLUMN "content" SET DEFAULT '';
